title: Property Charges and Statutory Rates on the Hotel Rate Plans
content:
Alongside the room rate, a Hotel Rate Plans reservation carries the property's own facility charge, parking, internet and the statutory rates the authorities levy. This schedule records all of them.

| Rate plan | Property facility fee, per room per night, USD | Facility fee waived | Occupancy tax, percent | City tax, percent | Self-parking, per room per night, USD | In-room internet included | In-room internet, per day, USD |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | 39.0 | no | 12.5 | 4.0 | 42.0 | no | 14.95 |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | 39.0 | no | 12.5 | 4.0 | 42.0 | yes | 0.0 |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | 35.0 | no | 12.5 | 4.0 | 38.0 | yes | 0.0 |
| Standard Flexible Rate | 35.0 | no | 12.5 | 4.0 | 35.0 | yes | 0.0 |
| Member Flex Rate | 29.0 | no | 12.5 | 4.0 | 28.0 | yes | 0.0 |
| Suite Flexible Rate | 45.0 | no | 12.5 | 4.0 | 35.0 | yes | 0.0 |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | 0.0 | yes | 12.5 | 4.0 | 0.0 | yes | 0.0 |

## Notes on the figures

The **property facility fee** is the mandatory facility charge per room per night; the All-Inclusive Flex Rate is the only plan that waives it, and it records 0.0 USD accordingly. The **occupancy tax** is the state or provincial rate applied to the room total, and the **city tax** the city or tourism rate; both stand at the same figure on every one of the seven plans, 12.5 percent and 4.0 percent. **Self-parking** runs from 28.0 USD on the Member Flex Rate to 42.0 USD on the Non-Refundable Saver Rate and the Advance Purchase 21 Rate, and is 0.0 USD on the All-Inclusive Flex Rate. **In-room internet** is included on every plan but the Non-Refundable Saver Rate, which records 14.95 USD per day.

*A worked reading.* Taking a hypothetical room total of 1,000.00 USD, the occupancy tax rate of 12.5 percent this schedule records comes to 125.00 USD and the city tax rate of 4.0 percent to 40.00 USD.
